activity_summary: You reached the door with the three and the boats still in their hands. Hamnet had run. Anne held the first word of the house for Joan. You had not yet put the boats down.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Brought the knife home, and would not answer twice.

entities.name: Anne Shakespeare
entities.context: Kept the path from becoming a procession.

entities.name: Joan Shakespeare
entities.context: Took the three at the door.

entities.name: Susanna Shakespeare
entities.context: Brought the book home dry, and did not ask.

entities.name: Hamnet Shakespeare
entities.context: Told the arch, and was not allowed to come on the path.

entities.name: Judith Shakespeare
entities.context: Put the boats on the step, and kept the name.
